It fixes the claim ladder; conditional versus complete-selection and prevalence boundaries; deterministic SHA-256 stream namespace; IID, temporal, repeated-subject, voxel/component/partial-null, rank, group, and nonfinite families; effect sizes; 10,000 null and 5,000 alternative confirmation counts; 1,999 transforms; exact Monte Carlo decision bands; independent simulator/oracle gates; and future artifact/command ownership. Higher-rank confirmation is the independently frozen compact-space stepwise/null-space-complete/nuisance-basis/closed-testing CCA candidate from Winkler et al.; R1/H2, R2/H3, and R3/H4 preserve earlier nonzero roots, while naive global shuffling is allowed only for rank zero. Historical group, noisy-SE, nuisance, and max-null failures remain mandatory adverse cases under their native existing tickets. Checks: local Markdown links resolve, DOI resolves, PMC source identifier resolves to the NCBI endpoint (automated HEAD receives the expected 203 challenge), no diff whitespace errors. This protocol makes no numerical passing or current provider-admission claim; M4.04-M4.09 and M5.02 own implementation/calibration.
